ios.desc:
Are you spending too much time on your phone? Struggling to focus and stay productive? Aphel helps you break free from distractions and take back control of your time.

Features:
Block distracting apps and websites
Set custom screen time limits
Track your phone usage and build better habits
Stay focused with smart reminders and focus modes
Reduce phone addiction and boost productivity
Black Focus is designed to help you cut down on unnecessary screen time, improve your focus, and be more mindful in your daily life. Whether you want to stay productive at work, study efficiently, or simply reduce social media usage, Black Focus provides the tools you need.

Start your journey towards a healthier digital lifestyle today.

show_hn.title: Show HN: I built Aphel – a focus app that helps you break phone addiction

quotes.text:
Hey HN,

I built Aphel, a focused and minimalist screen time app that helps you regain control over your phone usage and eliminate fake dopamine hits from addictive apps.

Most screen time apps are either too passive (just stats) or feel like parental controls. Aphel is built for people who want to build discipline without relying on motivation.

Key features:

Focus Timer with a strict mode that blocks selected apps until the timer ends

Automated schedules like "Work Hours" or "Night Reading"

Dopamine Load score that helps you visualize how much of your time was driven by distractions

Built using Apple’s native Screen Time API — no VPNs, no accessibility hacks

Fully private — no account required, no tracking, no ads

I built this for myself after getting frustrated with endless scrolling and losing hours of deep work. Aphel is designed to be a practical tool for self-respect and long-term focus.

You can try it here: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/aphel-screen-time-control/id6739789721

Happy to answer questions or share more about how I built it.

Thanks,
Can
